# Release Notes Instructions

Generate concise, user-facing notes for changes in this release.

- Group entries under `### Added`, `### Fixed`, `### Upgrade notes`, or `### Known issues`.
- Include only changes visible to users; omit internal refactors, tests, and CI-only changes.
- Describe compatibility or migration requirements only when the PR supports them; otherwise leave that section empty.
- Do not invent behavior. Flag ambiguous changes for maintainer review.
- Use concise bullets in present tense and include the pull request number when available.
